scene: The laser harp chimes, unlocking three glowing transit gates ahead.
picture: A flat side view along the sparkling bridge terminal. Far left, a glass karaoke lift door stands open. Left, the silver-haired boy in mint hoodie and dance bag stands beside the vibrating laser harp. Centre, a sleek light-rail pod waits with open hatch. Far right, an illuminated starlight moving walkway glides forward.
shown: a cylindrical glass lift glowing with music notes on the far left
a sleek light-rail pod waiting on a rail at the centre
